name: War Chest

categories.label: Won (placed all Control Markers)
categories.hint: Win immediately by being the first to place all your Control Markers on locations.

categories.label: Control Markers on board
categories.hint: Markers you have on locations when the game ended (6 per player in 2-player game).

winCondition: The game ends immediately when one player (or team in the 4-player game) has placed all of its Control Markers on locations (green knotwork hexes); that side wins. In the extremely rare case both players hold only Royal Coins with empty supplies, the game is a draw.

endCondition.description: First to place all Control Markers (6 per player in 2-player; each player starts with 2 on starting locations)

notes: family: area-majority (control of hex locations; no points). No point scoring. 4-player team game reportedly uses shared team markers (one summary says 8 per team) and was not verified against the official rulebook; scorers should tick the winner only. Official publisher rulebook PDF could not be retrieved; rules taken from Yucata's and RulesPal's rule text.
